summary.verdict: The implementation conforms to the motor_003 contract: it governs canonical vocabulary terms, aliases, taxonomy nodes and semantic boundaries with deterministic validation, structured rejections, provenance, versioning and lineage. No material boundary, metadata or responsibility-separation violations were found.

test_results.coverage_assessment: Smoke checks exercised the documented happy path, sparse root case, malformed missing-provenance rejection, duplicate canonical-term rejection, alias-collision rejection, missing-parent rejection, missing-boundary rejection and unsupported downstream-object rejection.
test_results.notes: Tests were executed directly against the Python service module from artifacts/implementation/codebase/service.py. They confirmed authorized taxonomy publication emits only canonical_term, alias_map, taxonomy_tree and boundary_definition outputs, and invalid inputs emit blocking TaxonomyValidationError records without partial publication.
